title: You’re Burning Through Your Claude Account
description:
Claude is not randomly getting worse during long projects.

In many cases, you are simply hitting the token limit.

Tokens are the small pieces AI uses to process information, and every conversation has a limited context window.

When that window fills up, performance drops, earlier details get lost, or the output stops.

Understanding tokens is one of the fastest ways to improve how you work with Claude.

🚀 You’ll find the link to our free AI classes in our profile.
